faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RNU Akashvani Srinagar \ Casual Newsreader cum Translator (Balti) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Casual Newsreader cum Translator (Balti) post is 15th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduation degree from any UGC-recognized university. Additionally, proficiency in reading, writing, and translating English/Urdu text into the Balti language is essential, along with a good broadcasting voice.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Casual Newsreader cum Translator (Balti) position?
faq.answer: The age limit for this position is between 21 years and 50 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, which are detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 354. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for candidates belonging to the SC/ST categories. They are exempt from paying the application fee for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Casual Newsreader cum Translator (Balti) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves two stages: a written test to assess your knowledge and language skills, followed by a voice test to evaluate your suitability for broadcasting standards.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Casual Newsreader cum Translator (Balti) is on a contractual basis. This means the employment is for a fixed term as per the terms and conditions specified in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Prasar Bharati at https://prasarbharati.gov.in/pbvacancies/. Always refer to the official sources for accurate information.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: You will need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, which typically include your photograph, signature, identity proof, and educational certificates. Please refer to the official notification for a complete list.
